adjusts.description: Raw ZPL configuration body (for example the ^MD darkness or ^PR speed commands); the upstream sends it and then ^XA^JUS^XZ to save it, without confirming the first write; the receipt remains unknown. The raw body can also contain print commands.
adjusts.name: configuration

device.name: Zebra label printer status and configuration (zebra_day.ZebraPrinter)

facts.text: send_command opens one AF_INET/SOCK_STREAM socket per call, connects to the printer address and port, sends the encoded command with sendall, reads one recv and returns the decoded reply; TimeoutError, ConnectionRefusedError and OSError are caught and become None
get_host_identification sends ~HI and parses a comma-separated reply into model, firmware, dpi, memory and options
get_serial_number sends ~HQSN and returns the first non-header line of the reply
get_error_status sends ~HQES and returns the first non-header line as raw, with errors and warnings left as empty lists because the flag parsing is not implemented
get_odometer sends ~HQOD and parses LABEL: and TOTAL INCHES: values into label_count and total_inches
get_host_status sends ~HS and parses paused, paper_out, head_up and ribbon_out from the first comma-separated line
get_configuration sends ^XA^HH^XZ; set_configuration sends the supplied configuration body and then ^XA^JUS^XZ to save it
get_full_status queries host identification, serial number, error status, odometer and host status, and stamps the result with time.time()
The hardware guide says network-attached Zebra printers that obtain an IP address and accept ZPL are supported, and that USB-only printers are not communicated with
The hardware guide's initial printer configuration list includes increasing the darkness and decreasing print speed to 2 or 3 IPS
The ZD620/ZD420 user guide lists both shutdown and delayed sleep after a 4-9 second POWER-button hold, and automatic power-on in Power Failure Recovery Mode
The ZD620/ZD420 user guide documents PAUSE stopping print and media movement after the current label and CANCEL cancelling the next format, or all pending formats while paused
The ZD620/ZD420 user guide warns that the printhead may be hot and could cause severe burns

measures.description: Combined printer status from get_full_status: online, identity, serial, error flags, odometer, paused, paper_out, ribbon_out and head_up (the wall-clock timestamp is omitted so a read alone does not change the state hash)
measures.name: status

safe_state.description: unconfirmed: the endpoint latch refuses new commands, but the upstream has no acknowledged printer stop; queued printing and printhead heating may continue and the e-stop reports SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED
